verdict.rationale: Linear's GraphQL developer docs describe something 'written in TypeScript, allowing all operations to be strongly typed,' which points to an official typed client. The same docs cover personal API key and OAuth2 auth and schema introspection. However, the pack never explicitly names an official SDK package, its installation, or its usage. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation (package name, install/usage guide), SDKs for languages beyond TypeScript, independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: It is written in TypeScript, allowing all operations to be strongly typed.
The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
